R7AB-grouse-walk-0001.recName: Willow River (Tabor Mt Staging Area 5) rec site
R7AB-grouse-walk-0001.recDirections: Drive east of Prince George for approximately 34 km, and turn right onto the England Creek Road (immediately before the Willow River bridge). Follow this road for 1.4km until you reach a fork in the road, and turn left at this fork. Proceed for another 400 metres and you will find the access to the site on the left side of the road.
R7AB-grouse-walk-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-9: about 11,872 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 6.81 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: a long walk from parking. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
